svg.title: GTA 6 攻略标注地图
svg.desc: 全境位置为方向参考，点击编号打开对应攻略的原视频局部定位图。
svg.metadata: Basemap: Rockstar Games; source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/media/artwork-wallpapers; downloaded: 2026-11-21; coordinate system: image pixels, top-left origin.
